name: Leaders & Followers
description: This course is part of a suite of three electives in management studies taught by Dr Grace Dixon (the other two being Organizational Process and Critical Management Studies ). Students who have completed these courses recommend starting with Organizational Process before considering Leaders and Followers . It can, nevertheless, be taken as a standalone module. Please be aware that this course is conducted in collaboration with an external organization. There is an established time and effort commitment built into the course (see course summary below)
